csv_project_name: Design for Moreno Valley Yard MVU Office & Site Development
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Moreno Valley is seeking a consultant to design a permit-ready approximately 20,000 sq ft office and warehouse/garage facility at the Corporate Yard, including related parking, storage areas, and a security perimeter with an access gate and security block wall. The consultant shall provide full multidisciplinary design services including architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, lighting, communications, fire protection, civil, landscaping, stormwater/WQMP/hydrology studies, geotechnical engineering/soils report, surveying/utility locating, permit submission and review, and construction administration support. The project will ensure code compliance and integrate future-ready features like EV infrastructure, solar, and battery backup. The scope also covers site improvements with new fleet parking lots and construction support services to ensure successful project delivery.
